failures.reason: ResizeObserver reads animated bottom before the final control-height offset
Style observation alone still reads the transition starting value
Fault injection used unregistered callbacks, which real Events.remove does not invoke

limits: Source fixture validation only; final CORE-14 installed UMD and legacy validation remains outstanding
Transactional update and panel-render rollback, independent header cleanup and reentry remain unfinished
Cross-instance sharing/reuse, switch/range, long text and mobile/rotation still need coverage
No generic rollback of arbitrary getter/setter or Proxy side effects; failed new input may retain hidden metadata
Without ResizeObserver, external container resize requires the existing window/core resize signal
